audit.why: Gangplank taking every stage but 2+ items matches 30% over 10 games - the harshest number in this champion's table - and the content layer already explains it correctly: physical poke that Void Stone does nothing about, delivered from outside your range. Chart left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's spike model was 'when Powder Kegs is down', and dosFull[2].d offered a 'fifteen-second invitation' on it.
audit.why: Powder Keg has no cooldown to wait out - it is charge-based, listed at 0 in the kit - so that advice can never be acted on. The cooldowns that actually gate him are Remove Scurvy at 22/20/18/16/14s and Cannon Barrage at 160/140/120s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[9].t and loading rebuilt around Remove Scurvy and Cannon Barrage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page states in three places that 'Parrrley out-ranges your point-and-click Null Sphere'. It does not: Parrrley is 625 and Null Sphere is 650. What actually out-ranges you is Powder Keg at 1000, which is a different problem with a different answer.
audit.why: If you believe his Q out-ranges yours you never contest; knowing you win the 625-vs-650 gap means you can trade back whenever there is no barrel in reach.
audit.corrected: Corrected in content.spikes[0].text, content.early, content.whys[0] and full.report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy was mentioned as 'cleanses any peel' but never given a cooldown, and its heal was never named.
audit.why: 22 seconds at rank 1. That is the window where your slow actually sticks and where his sustain is not available - the only forward step this lane offers before items.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' with no source named.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy is the sustain, and it also cures crowd control - so Grievous Wounds is doing double duty here, and armour rather than MR is the resist that matters against Parrrley and kegs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannon Barrage was never described as global.
audit.why: It is listed at 30000 range with a global flag - he can swing a fight in any lane without leaving yours, so a Gangplank who is losing top can still be winning the map.
audit.corrected: Added to report[5].t's neighbours via breakdown.cooldowns and loading.

notes: RANGE ERROR in three places: 'Parrrley out-ranges your point-and-click Null Sphere'. Parrrley is 625 and Null Sphere is 650, so Kassadin wins that gap - it is Powder Keg at 1000 that out-ranges him. The fix matters because it changes when you may step up. Also removed the 'when Powder Kegs is down' timing model from the full layer: Powder Keg is charge-based with no cooldown listed, so there was never a window to wait for; the real one is Remove Scurvy at 22s. Did not write anything about Cannon Barrage dealing true damage - the kit carries a trueDamage flag but Riot's description only says it slows and damages, so I named it global (explicit, 30000 range) and left the damage type alone.
